name: Python 3.14
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y < packages.txt; fi; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then pipx install uv; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$HOME/.venvs/zenith-1-pro" uv sync --locked

postAttachCommand.server: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$HOME/.venvs/zenith-1-pro" uv run --locked streamlit run streamlit_app.py
